usage: cox chair service [-h] [--install] [--status] [--label LABEL] [--interval INTERVAL]
                         [--environment-file ENVIRONMENT_FILE] [--profile PROFILE] [--host HOST]
                         [--apply]

--install writes ~/.config/systemd/user/coxswain-chair.service and prints the systemctl lines.
It does not run systemctl.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --install             write the unit file and print the systemctl lines to run; runs nothing
                        itself
  --status              print the unit file, or say there is none
  --label LABEL         the chair's holder label (default: $COX_SESSION_LABEL, else unlabeled)
  --interval INTERVAL   seconds between ticks (default: 60)
  --environment-file ENVIRONMENT_FILE
                        env file the unit loads (default: ~/.config/agent-tools/garage.env when it
                        exists)
  --profile PROFILE     the routing profile naming workspace_dir, pinned in the unit's ExecStart
                        (default: ~/.config/agent-tools/profile.yaml or $AGENT_TOOLS_PROFILE)
  --host HOST           a hosts-table name: install or report on that lane host over ssh
  --apply               with --install --host, run the steps instead of printing them
